# File format fixtures

These files were generated locally from synthetic text, using python-docx,
python-pptx, openpyxl, the Python standard library, and Aspose Email FOSS for
MSG. The Office variants have their own
format-specific content types; their macro-enabled names do not contain VBA.
The email samples have no attachments, and the MHTML sample only references its
embedded page. The EPUB contains only its manifest and one XHTML page.

The files are intentionally small and contain no real personal data. A static
inspection checked the Office and EPUB archives for VBA projects, embedded
objects, external links and ActiveX parts, and the MSG compound file for
attachments. This inspection is not an antivirus scan.
